episodes.synopsis: Having lost his parents in a car crash, Yuuri is left to live in the mansion on his own. One day, a beautiful maid, Lilith, shows up, offering to work for him for free.
episodes.title: The Maid I Hired Recently Is Mysterious

episodes.synopsis: Yuuri has gotten used to living with Lilith, but he’s still suspicious of her. One day, he spots her leaving the building seeming somewhat anxious.
episodes.title: The Young Master, the Cat, and the Morning Glory

episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa, a classmate of Yuuri's, is concerned for his well-being after having lost his parents.
episodes.title: Gojouin Tsukasa Is Precocious

episodes.synopsis: Lilith becomes desperate to convince Yuuri that she is not suspicious.
episodes.title: Does the Young Master Like Pudding?

episodes.synopsis: Lilith helps Yuuri prepare for the upcoming sports day events.
episodes.title: My Precious...

episodes.synopsis: Yuuri finds himself taking care of Lilith for once when she catches a cold.
episodes.title: The Maid I Hired Recently Is Weird!?

episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa invites Yuuri over for a discussion about love.
episodes.title: Not in My Textbook

episodes.synopsis: Lilith approaches Fujisaki for advice on how to get Yuuri to open up to her more.
episodes.title: The Girl With the Purple Eyes

episodes.synopsis: Lilith's former coworker and classmate, Natsume, comes knocking on Yuuri's door, demanding that Lilith comes back.
episodes.title: Complicated, Convoluted, Perplexing, Honest Feelings

episodes.synopsis: Christmas is coming, and Yuuri and Natsume plot a surprise party for Lilith.
episodes.title: For Whom Do the Stars Fall

episodes.synopsis: A man visits the mansion while Natsume and Yuuri are out running errands.
episodes.title: It Must Have Always Been...
